algorithm: Extracted only the literal urlManager rules array from the frozen PHP source, without loading deployment configuration.
Expanded every yii\rest\UrlRule through the installed Yii framework, including the default inherited patterns and wildcard OptionsAction fallbacks.
Resolved inline controller actions by Reflection; resolved actions() maps on constructor-free controller instances. No action, behavior, database or provider request was executed.
Enumerated GET, HEAD, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, OPTIONS and preserved first matching declaration for each method/path template.
Kept missing controllers and missing actions as source 404 records; controller methods without any strict URL rule are listed separately.
